tools.name: get_vault
tools.description: Live state of the HITZ Sovereign Vault: each pool's reserves, HITZ price, current fee and dislocation, USD values, and the HITZ Event Horizon (the most HITZ an account can hold and still send it anywhere).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: A Stellar account's XLM, USDC and HITZ balances, its trustlines, whether it is vaulted, and how much HITZ it can buy before being vaulted.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Exact quote from the contract's own math: the amount out, price, fees per hop and price impact. Give amount (what is sold) or buy_amount (what should come out; the quote finds the input). Pass account to check its balances, trustlines and whether the trade would push it over the Event Horizon.

tools.name: build_swap
tools.description: Build an unsigned, simulated swap transaction for the user's own Stellar account, ready to sign. Returns the XDR, the expected and minimum amounts, the network fee, warnings, and sign links: sign.web opens a skyhitz.io page where the user signs with their own wallet and the swap is submitted; sign.s

tools.name: submit_transaction
tools.description: Submit a signed vault transaction (from build_swap, signed by the user) to Stellar mainnet and wait for the result: status, hash, explorer link and the amount bought. Only relays calls to the vault.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Status of a transaction by hash, with a vault swap decoded (what was sold and bought).
